I'm checking each user story criterion in turn: QUS-001 passes since the role, action, and benefit are all present, QUS-002 passes as a single atomic objective, and QUS-003 passes with no parentheses. For QUS-004, the benefit of keeping the schedule free of unneeded activities is a real purpose, so it passes too. I'm still working through QUS-005, where the solution wording about deleting tasks looks acceptable.

I'm going through QUS-006 and weighing whether "tasks" and "activities" are being used as the same thing, since that could be ambiguous, though I'm leaning toward passing it. QUS-007 and QUS-008 look fine, with no conflicts or duplicates, and I'm now checking whether the language and format match the other stories in the catalog.

I'm checking the remaining invest criteria now. The story looks independent since it doesn't reference other stories, and its benefit is stated clearly, so it's valuable. I'm also judging it estimable from the dialog details, though I'm noting that recurrence and whether deletion is soft or hard aren't mentioned.

I'm checking the remaining DOR criteria now. The story doesn't seem to need an external integration, since the parents' view is already in place, and the business rules look explicit enough, with the error case and admin-only permission covered. I'm also questioning whether DOR-003 applies at all, since the story isn't critical or high-volume.

I'm checking that there's no title criterion to flag, since the title being empty isn't among the listed checks. Then I'm noting that the acceptance criteria are written in English, while the skill calls for Spanish, but the similar backlog stories are also in English, so I'm weighing whether that mix counts as a defect under QUS-009.

I'm weighing whether the wording about "tasks" versus "activities" and the unstated date cutoff for "already took place" make this story ambiguous, but both seem reasonably clear from context. The story looks small and bounded, with a confirmation dialog and a lock on past activities, so I'm leaning toward accepting it and estimating it from those details.

Next I'm estimating the story by calling the estimation tools in parallel.

input.historia_refinada: Como administrador del campamento, quiero poder eliminar las tareas o actividades que programé, para mantener el calendario limpio de actividades innecesarias.
criterios_aceptacion: Cada tarea o actividad programada muestra la opción Eliminar solo a los administradores del campamento.
Antes de eliminar, se muestra un diálogo de confirmación con el nombre de la actividad, el grupo y la fecha.
Si el administrador confirma, la actividad desaparece del calendario y de los horarios que ven los trabajadores y los padres.
Si la actividad ya se realizó, la opción Eliminar aparece deshabilitada con el mensaje "Past activities are kept for records".

criterios_aceptacion: Cada tarea o actividad programada muestra la opción Eliminar solo a los administradores del campamento.
Antes de eliminar, se muestra un diálogo de confirmación con el nombre de la actividad, el grupo y la fecha.
Si el administrador confirma, la actividad desaparece del calendario y de los horarios que ven los trabajadores y los padres.
Si la actividad ya se realizó, la opción Eliminar aparece deshabilitada con el mensaje "Past activities are kept for records".
